answer: Each agent submits a PUW by running a stochastic dune‑terrain generator that emits a signed hash; the ledger logs the ripple of that hash across a terrace of sequential challenge epochs and automatically rejects any duplicate or near‑duplicate output. To create a fake identity, an attacker must lock 5,000 tokens for 24 epochs per identity, losing the full stake if a collision occurs, so each Sybil node costs 5,000 tokens and 24 epochs.
